subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements about Swami Dayanand Saraswati is INCORRECT?

options.text: He was the founder of Arya Samaj.
He was the founder of Brahmo Samaj.

solution:
__**He was the founder of Brahmo Samaj**__ is NOT correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Brahmo Samaj** was founded by **Raja Ram Mohan Roy.**

 
 
• Brahmo Samaj was a monotheistic sect of Hinduism.
 
• It was founded as Brahmo Sabha in **1828.**
 
• **Brahmo Sabha** was later renamed as Brahmo Samaj.
